mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals labor market tightening that accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages indicates strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with both RSAFS and HOUST above 3mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 5.5%), the economy enters a supply-driven expansion phase that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO > 105.0 and UNRATE < 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates strengthening supply conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO > 105.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high labor force participation (PAYEMS > 142,000 thousand) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%), the labor market sustains consumer spending growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with PAYEMS > 142000 and UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,200 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity that boosts related sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
